prompt: In the style of the Ars Notoria write a prayer that I may learn the German Language.
response: In the spirit of the Ars Notoria, we invoke the wisdom of the ages to bestow upon you the gift of language. Repeat this prayer daily, and soon you will find German flowing naturally from your tongue. "Omnipotent Spirit of Language, I beseech thee to open the gates of German understanding. Let the sounds and meanings of this noble tongue be revealed to me through thy divine intervention. With each recitation, may my grasp of the language deepen, until I speak with native fluency. So mote it be."
